literal: Unfailing harvest-and, worthy people-and, decline-without wealthy people-and, coming together is a country.
translation: A country is that which brings together unfailing harvests, worthy people, and wealthy citizens free from decline.
modern: குறையாத விளைச்சலும், தகுதியுடைய சான்றோர்களும், வறுமையோ தாழ்வோ இல்லாத செல்வந்தர்களும் ஒன்று கூடி வாழ்வதே ஒரு சிறந்த நாடாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the three essential components that constitute a great nation. First, it must have 'taḷḷā viḷaiyuḷ', which refers to agricultural yields that never fail, ensuring food security. Second, it must have 'takkār', meaning righteous and worthy people who maintain moral order. Third, it must have 'tāḻvilā celvar', wealthy citizens whose prosperity does not decline, enabling them to support others and contribute to the state's economy.
